protocol.primary: held-out test cross-entropy at a matched optimizer step and token budget
protocol.secondary: CIFAR test accuracy, runtime, and realized momentum spectra
protocol.learning_rate_selection: minimum mean final validation loss on tuning seeds, per arm and precision
protocol.fitted_selection: minimum mean final CIFAR validation loss among fp32 fitted entries after per-arm LR selection
protocol.followup: selected fp32 fit, Keller, exact SVD, plus bf16 versions of selected fit and Keller
protocol.confirmation: fresh seeds; final checkpoint only; test set never selects any hyperparameter
protocol.compute_matching: all polynomial arms use five steps; all arms within each stage use the same number of optimizer steps and same data seed schedule
protocol.cost_matching: exact SVD is an outcome anchor; its extra cost is measured separately
protocol.interpretation: budget-limited evidence for this family, architecture and token regime, not universal optimality
